sql_templates.description: Fetch latest sector breadth with stage 2 participation
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_sectors AS (
    SELECT sector, pct_above_50dma, change_5d, breadth_signal
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)
), latest_stages AS (
    SELECT sector, COUNT(*) as stage2_count
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
    GROUP BY sector
)
SELECT ls.sector, ls.pct_above_50dma, ls.change_5d, ls.breadth_signal, ls2.stage2_count
FROM latest_sectors ls
JOIN latest_stages ls2 ON ls.sector = ls2.sector
ORDER BY ls2.stage2_count DESC
LIMIT 10

synthesis_guidance: ['Compare sector ranks based on breadth and stage participation.', 'Highlight improving sectors and potential symbols.', 'Provide a clear list of symbols for use in TradingView watchlists.']
title: Sector Breadth Rotation Watchlist Variant 1903
